paragraphs: Plains of Jarin

Tahlkora: I'm telling you the truth. I've been following General Kahyet around. She's up to no good! Jerek: "You're telling me that a Kournan general is making deals with our enemies? That one of Warmarshal Varesh's own is a traitor? These are serious accusations." You'd better be certain about your information, or...." Tahlkora: "I...I know what I saw. I found their meeting place with the corsairs...in the Keys! And I'm NOT leaving until you listen to me." Mehtani Keys
Tahlkora: "I swear they were here! Where did they go? Now you won't believe me either." Tahlkora: "Hmm...well, they were going this way. Let's proceed. Maybe we'll find a clue."
After killing the corsairs

sections.heading: Reward dialogue
paragraphs: Jerek Quite the heroic bunch, defeating a scroll! And you cut it up into tiny pieces! I'm sorry, but a cryptic scroll and a pile of rusty coins are hardly evidence of anything. She claims she can decipher the message? Fine. You pursue this. I'll spare no more Sunspear resources on it. And take her with you. She's under your command now. Tell her she's an honorary Sunspear. Maybe that will keep her quiet.

sections.heading: Notes
paragraphs: A Cryptic Scroll Piece and a Bag of Kournan Coins spawn in Mehtani Keys as part of this quest. While they can, and should, be picked up, they will not appear in inventory. If you follow Tahlkora after the dialogue ends, she will run into the Champion's Dawn portal.
Bug. Tahlkora will heal and enchant foes while this quest is active.

Quest information[edit]

Requirements[edit]

  • Elonian (Nightfall) character

Objectives[edit]

  • Report to Jerek.
  • Travel to the Mehtani Keys and investigate Tahlkora's allegations.
  • See Jerek for your reward.

Reward[edit]

  • 1,000 Experience
  • Tahlkora joins your party.
  • 125 Gold
  • 10 Sunspear Promotion Points

Walkthrough[edit]

Head outside the Sunspear Great Hall to talk to Jerek. Then travel to Kodlonu Hamlet and head out into Mehtani Keys. Tahlkora will follow your party. Simply follow the quest marker (be wary of mandragor popups along the way) to find a Cryptic Scroll Piece and Bag of Kournan Coins. Pick up the scroll piece and report back to Jerek.

You may wish to visit the Treasure Chest on the island to the south of where the clues were found.

NPCs[edit]

  • 20 Jerek
